story.title: The Horse Man of the Sierra Madre

sentences.text: If a tall stranger follows you at night in the mountains of the Philippines... don't look back.
The old tales say a traveler walking through the dark forest might notice the shadows stretching strangely.
Footprints left in the damp earth suddenly turn into massive, heavy hooves.
According to the legends, the figure can transform into a towering beast with the body of a man and the head of a horse.
It paces just beyond the flickering lantern light, leading wanderers in endless circles.
Those who try to escape find themselves hopelessly lost among the twisting vines and ancient trees.
A sudden violent rush shatters the silence, and a lantern drops into the dirt.
Only a chilling wind remains on the desolate trail where someone was dragged away into the brush.
